title: Apply to change the vessel on a private mooring licence
summary: Find out how to apply to Transport for NSW (TfNSW) to change the vessel associated with your private mooring licence.
intro:
If you want to change the vessel that's on your private mooring licence, you need to apply to Transport for NSW (TfNSW).

Your application will be assessed on a range of factors including:

Note: Additional approvals/permits from other agencies may also be required, so to avoid the possibility of your application not being permitted to proceed, it's recommended you contact TfNSW before purchasing a vessel.
who_can_apply: Must have a private mooring licence.
Must apply to Transport for NSW (TfNSW).
what_you_need: The 'Application to Change Vessel on Mooring' PDF form
A recent photo of the vessel

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by post or email to the details on the form.

more_info.text: The vessel must be at least 5.2 metres in length, unless otherwise approved by Transport for NSW.
Concessions (if applicable) are only available for vessels used solely for recreational purposes.

faqs.q: What do I need to change the vessel on my private mooring licence?
faqs.a: You will need the 'Application to Change Vessel on Mooring' PDF form, a recent photo of the vessel, proof of identity, and your payment.

faqs.q: How do I submit my application to change the vessel?
faqs.a: You can complete the form and submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by post or email using the details provided on the form.

faqs.q: Are there any other requirements besides the application?
faqs.a: Additional approvals or permits from other agencies may be required. It is recommended that you contact TfNSW before purchasing a vessel to avoid issues with your application.
